neighbours.label: ' on' after 'click' in user-interface instructions
fire: To save your draft, simply click on the disk icon in the toolbar.
If the window freezes, click on the title bar and wait a moment.
Open the settings page and click on Privacy to change who sees you.
You can download the report: just click on the link in the email.
In the photo editor, click on the area you want to sharpen.
After signing in, click on your name to see your order history.
Users should click on Accept before continuing to the checkout.
To mute a chat, right-click on it and choose the bell option.
quiet: To save your draft, simply press Ctrl and S at the same time.
If the window freezes, close the program and wait a moment.
Open the settings page and select Privacy to change who sees you.
You can download the report from the link in the email.
In the photo editor, choose the area you want to sharpen.
After signing in, your name appears with your order history.
Users should put the cart on hold before leaving the checkout.
To mute a chat, open it and choose the bell option.

notes: Card: ' on' is the peak token of 29 of the top 32, nearly all 'click on'. Near misses keep UI instructions without 'click on', and use 'on' in other senses.
